metadata.source: Government of India Official Portals & State Government Portals
metadata.description: Curated dataset of 50 high-impact Indian government welfare schemes (25 Central + 25 State) for AI-powered multilingual scheme assistant

benefits.summary: ₹6,000 per year in 3 equal installments of ₹2,000 directly to bank account

steps: Visit pmkisan.gov.in
Click on 'New Farmer Registration'
Select Rural or Urban Farmer
Enter Aadhaar number and state
Fill land and bank details
Submit form and note registration number

special_categories: Economically Weaker Sections as per SECC 2011
eligibility.eligibility_basis: Socio-Economic Caste Census (SECC) 2011 deprivation and occupational criteria

benefits.summary: Cashless health insurance up to ₹5 lakh per family per year
additional_perks: Covers secondary and tertiary hospitalization
Valid at 25,000+ empanelled hospitals nationwide

steps: Visit nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) or empanelled hospital
Check eligibility at pmjay.gov.in or helpline 14555
Submit Aadhaar and ration card for verification
Register and get Ayushman card printed
Use card at any empanelled hospital for cashless treatment

exclusions: Must not own a pucca house anywhere in India

benefits.summary: Interest subsidy of 3%-6.5% on home loans; maximum subsidy up to ₹2.67 lakh
additional_perks: Subsidy directly credited to loan account
Reduces EMI burden significantly

documents_required: Affidavit of not owning a pucca house

steps: Visit pmaymis.gov.in
Select income category (EWS / LIG / MIG)
Fill application form with personal and property details
Upload all required documents
Submit form and note application ID
Track application status online

exclusions: Farm sector / agricultural activities not covered

benefits.summary: Collateral-free business loans in 4 tiers: Shishu up to ₹50K, Kishore up to ₹5L, Tarun up to ₹10L, Tarun Plus up to ₹20L
additional_perks: No collateral required
Mudra RuPay card for working capital

documents_required: Business Plan or Proof of Existing Business
Quotation of machinery/equipment to be purchased

steps: Visit any nationalized/private bank, RRB, or MFI
Collect and fill Mudra loan application form
Attach all required documents
Bank conducts credit assessment
Loan disbursed after approval

schemes.ministry: Ministry of Electronics & IT (Platform) / Multiple Ministries

eligibility.income_note: Varies by scholarship: ₹1 lakh to ₹3.5 lakh depending on scheme and ministry

benefits.summary: Financial assistance from ₹1,000 to ₹50,000+ per year depending on scholarship and category
additional_perks: Single portal for 100+ central and state scholarships
Direct transfer to student bank account

steps: Visit scholarships.gov.in
Register with Aadhaar-linked mobile number
Complete student profile and login
Select applicable scholarship from list
Fill application form with academic details
Upload all required documents
Submit before deadline and note application ID

benefits.summary: Guaranteed monthly pension of ₹1,000-₹5,000 after age 60 based on contribution amount
additional_perks: Spouse continues receiving pension after subscriber's death
Nominee receives corpus on spouse's death

documents_required: Active Mobile Number linked to bank account
APY Subscriber Registration Form (filled at bank)

steps: Visit bank, post office, or access net banking
Obtain and fill APY subscriber registration form
Select desired monthly pension amount (₹1000 to ₹5000)
Submit form with Aadhaar and bank details
Set up auto-debit mandate for monthly contribution
Receive APY Permanent Retirement Account Number (PRAN)

schemes.scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana

benefits.summary: Life insurance cover of ₹2 lakh on death; annual premium of only ₹436
additional_perks: Auto-debit from bank account
Nominee receives ₹2 lakh on any cause of death

documents_required: Nominee details (name, relation, date of birth)

steps: Visit bank or access net banking / mobile banking app
Fill PMJJBY consent-cum-declaration form with nominee details
Submit form at bank branch or enroll online
₹436 auto-debited annually from bank account on 1st June
Receive policy certificate

benefits.summary: Accidental death or total disability cover ₹2 lakh; partial disability ₹1 lakh; annual premium ₹20
additional_perks: Covers accidental death and permanent total/partial disability
Auto-debit of ₹20/year from bank account

documents_required: Nominee details (name, relation, date of birth)

steps: Visit bank or access net banking / banking app
Fill PMSBY consent-cum-declaration form with nominee details
Submit form at bank or enroll digitally
₹20 auto-debited annually from bank account

schemes.scheme_name: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act

occupation: any adult willing to do unskilled manual work

benefits.summary: Guaranteed 100 days of paid wage employment per household per year at ₹200-₹350/day (state-dependent)
additional_perks: Work within 5 km of residence
Unemployment allowance if work not provided in 15 days

documents_required: Bank or Post Office Account Passbook

steps: Visit Gram Panchayat office with all documents
Fill MGNREGA Job Card application form
Gram Panchayat registers household and issues Job Card free of cost
Submit written demand for work to Gram Panchayat
Work allocated within 15 days of demand

languages_supported: All regional languages via Gram Panchayat

benefits.summary: 5 kg free food grain (wheat/rice) per person per month under National Food Security Act
additional_perks: Completely free since merger into NFSA (Jan 2023)
Available at all Fair Price Shops nationwide

documents_required: Aadhaar Card (for biometric authentication at ration shop)

steps: Obtain Ration Card from local food office or CSC if not held
Visit nearest Fair Price Shop (ration shop) monthly
Authenticate via Aadhaar biometric on ePoS machine
Collect monthly free grain allocation

languages_supported: All regional languages via ration shops

exclusions: Workers already covered under EPFO or ESIC not eligible

benefits.summary: e-Shram card with Universal Account Number (UAN); ₹2 lakh accident insurance via PMSBY; priority welfare access
additional_perks: Portable UAN card recognized across states
Priority access to government welfare schemes
Used for disaster relief and emergency DBT

steps: Visit eshram.gov.in or nearest CSC
Enter Aadhaar number and verify with mobile OTP
Fill occupation, income, and state details
Enter bank account details
Download e-Shram card instantly (UAN auto-generated)

schemes.ministry: Ministry of MSME / Ministry of Skill Development & Entrepreneurship

exclusions: Only one member per family eligible
special_categories: Traditional artisans and craftspeople (18 listed trades)

benefits.summary: Free skill training + ₹500/day stipend + toolkit grant ₹15,000 + credit up to ₹3 lakh at 5% interest
additional_perks: PM Vishwakarma Certificate and digital ID card
Digital transaction cashback incentives
Market linkage and branding support

documents_required: Proof of trade/occupation (self-declaration or Gram Panchayat / ULB verification letter)
Caste Certificate (optional but recommended for SC/ST)

steps: Register at pmvishwakarma.gov.in or nearest CSC
Enter Aadhaar number for biometric verification
Select trade/occupation from 18 listed trades
Get verification from Gram Panchayat or Urban Local Body
Attend free skill training at Training Centre of Excellence (TCoE)
Receive PM Vishwakarma card, toolkit grant, and credit access

benefits.summary: Free LPG connection (cylinder + stove) and first refill subsidy for BPL women
additional_perks: EMI facility for stove and first refill
Deposit-free LPG connection

documents_required: BPL Ration Card or any one of: Forest Rights Card, SECC data card, Antyodaya card, SC/ST certificate
Self-declaration for not having LPG connection

steps: Visit nearest LPG distributor (HP Gas / Indane / Bharat Gas)
Collect and fill PMUY KYC application form
Submit BPL / identity documents and photo
Sign self-declaration of no existing LPG connection
Connection issued after document verification

exclusions: Must not have received investment from central Govt schemes previously

benefits.summary: Grant up to ₹20 lakh for PoC/prototype; loan/convertible debenture up to ₹50 lakh for market entry
benefits.grant: Up to ₹20 lakh (proof of concept / prototype)
additional_perks: Disbursed through empanelled incubators
Mentorship and incubation ecosystem access

steps: Register startup at startupindia.gov.in and obtain DPIIT recognition
Browse empanelled incubators at seedfund.startupindia.gov.in
Apply through selected empanelled incubator on portal
Submit business plan and required documents
Incubator evaluates and selects eligible startups
Funds disbursed in tranches based on milestones

benefits.summary: Awareness campaigns + linkage with SSY savings + state conditional cash transfers + school enrollment support
additional_perks: State-specific conditional cash transfers for girl child families
Linkage with Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
Free education support and school enrollment drives
Anganwadi-level monitoring

documents_required: Passport Size Photo of girl child

steps: Register girl child at local Anganwadi centre
Open Sukanya Samriddhi account at bank or post office
Avail state-specific conditional cash transfer benefits
Ensure girl's enrollment in school and regular attendance

benefits.summary: Revolving crop credit up to ₹3 lakh at 4% effective interest (7% base minus 3% subvention for timely repayment)
additional_perks: Covers crop, post-harvest, and farm maintenance expenses
Covers fishery and animal husbandry needs
Card issued within 14 working days

documents_required: Land Records (Khasra / Khatauni) or Tenancy / Lease Agreement
No Dues Certificate from other banks (if applicable)

steps: Visit nearest bank (PSB, cooperative bank, or RRB)
Collect and fill KCC application form
Submit land records or tenancy documents
Bank verifies land holding and crops
Card issued within 14 working days of approval

benefits.summary: Free nutritional supplements, health monitoring, and counselling via Anganwadi centres
additional_perks: Supplementary nutrition at Anganwadi centres
Growth monitoring for children under 6
Health counselling for pregnant and lactating women
Targets reduction in stunting, wasting, and anaemia

steps: Visit nearest Anganwadi centre
Register with Anganwadi Sevika / Sahayika
Submit Aadhaar and MCP card for registration
Enroll for supplementary nutrition and health monitoring
Attend regular health check-ups and nutrition sessions

languages_supported: All regional languages via Anganwadi workers

eligibility.age_note: Girl child must be 10 years or below at time of account opening

benefits.summary: High-interest savings at 8.2% p.a. (Q1 2024-25); tax-free maturity; partial withdrawal at 18 for education
additional_perks: Tax deduction under Section 80C
Tax-free interest and maturity amount
Partial withdrawal (50%) at age 18 for higher education
Minimum deposit ₹250, maximum ₹1.5 lakh per year

documents_required: Passport Size Photo of girl child and parent
SSY Account Opening Form (available at bank / post office)

steps: Visit any authorized bank or post office
Collect and fill SSY account opening form
Submit girl child's birth certificate and parent Aadhaar
Make initial deposit (minimum ₹250)
Receive SSY passbook

languages_supported: Regional languages via post offices and banks

benefits.summary: Bank loans between ₹10 lakh to ₹1 crore for new greenfield enterprises for SC/ST/Women
additional_perks: Composite loan (term + working capital)
Repayment period up to 7 years with 18-month moratorium

documents_required: No Dues Certificate from other banks

steps: Apply at standupmitra.in or visit nearest bank branch
Register on portal with PAN and Aadhaar
Fill loan application form and upload project report
Bank evaluates project viability and creditworthiness
Loan approval and disbursement

benefits.summary: Free skill training in 300+ job roles; certification recognized by industry; monetary reward on certification
benefits.training_duration: 3 months to 1 year depending on course
benefits.type: Free Skill Training + Certification + Cash Reward
additional_perks: NSQF-aligned certification
Placement assistance after training
Training in sectors like IT, construction, beauty, healthcare, retail

steps: Visit pmkvyofficial.org or nearest PMKVY training centre
Register with Aadhaar and mobile number
Select preferred job role and training centre
Undergo free skill training
Appear for assessment; receive NSQF certification
Receive monetary reward and placement assistance

special_categories: Pregnant women from BPL / SC / ST households
All pregnant women in Low Performing States (LPS)

benefits.summary: Cash assistance of ₹1,400 (rural) and ₹1,000 (urban) to BPL pregnant women for institutional delivery
additional_perks: Free delivery at government hospitals
ASHA worker support for antenatal care
Post-delivery cash incentive

documents_required: BPL Ration Card or SC/ST Certificate

steps: Register pregnancy with nearest ANM or Anganwadi Sevika
Obtain JSY beneficiary card
Attend all antenatal care (ANC) check-ups
Deliver at government hospital or accredited private hospital
Cash transferred to bank account after institutional delivery

languages_supported: All regional languages via ANM and ASHA workers

benefits.summary: Crop insurance covering losses due to natural calamities; premium only 2% (Kharif), 1.5% (Rabi), 5% (horticulture)
additional_perks: Covers sowing failure, mid-season adversity, post-harvest losses
Balance premium paid by Central and State Governments

steps: Visit pmfby.gov.in or nearest bank / CSC
Fill PMFBY proposal form with crop and land details
Submit land records and Aadhaar
Pay farmer's share of premium
Receive policy number and certificate

languages_supported: Regional languages via CSC and banks

benefits.summary: Zero-balance savings account with RuPay debit card, ₹2 lakh accident insurance, ₹30,000 life cover, and overdraft facility up to ₹10,000
additional_perks: Free RuPay Debit Card
No minimum balance required
Direct DBT transfer eligibility
Mobile banking facility

documents_required: PMJDY Account Opening Form (available at bank)
Voter ID / Driving License (alternate ID if no Aadhaar)

steps: Visit nearest bank branch or Business Correspondent (BC) agent
Fill PMJDY account opening form
Submit Aadhaar card and passport photo
Account opened immediately with zero balance
Receive RuPay debit card and passbook

languages_supported: All regional languages via bank branches

special_categories: Children from EWS and disadvantaged groups

benefits.summary: Free textbooks, uniforms, mid-day meals, transport allowance, and residential schools for EWS children from Class 1 to 12
additional_perks: Free uniforms (2 sets per year for girls, SC/ST)
Free textbooks for all government school children
Mid-day meal (PM Poshan) for Classes 1-8
Transport allowance for remote area children
Special support for children with disabilities

steps: Enroll child at nearest government school
Submit birth certificate and Aadhaar at school
School registers child in Samagra Shiksha database
Free benefits (books, uniforms, meals) provided automatically

languages_supported: All regional languages via state education departments

benefits.summary: Working capital micro-loans in 3 escalating rounds: ₹10,000 then ₹20,000 then ₹50,000 with 7% interest subsidy
additional_perks: 7% annual interest subsidy
Digital transaction cashback up to ₹1,200/year

documents_required: Certificate of Vending (CoV) issued by ULB or Letter of Recommendation (LoR) from Town Vending Committee

steps: Visit pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in or nearest ULB office
Check eligibility and apply online with Aadhaar
Upload Certificate of Vending or Letter of Recommendation
Select lending institution (bank / MFI / SHG)
Loan disbursed post approval

schemes.scheme_name: Mahatma Jyotirao Phule Jan Arogya Yojana

benefits.summary: Cashless treatment up to ₹5 lakh per family per year at empanelled hospitals across Maharashtra
additional_perks: Covers 1,000+ procedures across 30+ specialities
Works in conjunction with PM-JAY for enhanced coverage

steps: Visit any empanelled hospital in Maharashtra
Show ration card and Aadhaar at Aarogya Mitra counter
Eligibility verified on-spot via portal
Avail cashless treatment immediately

special_categories: All families registered on Jan Aadhaar card

benefits.summary: Cashless treatment up to ₹25 lakh per family per year; one of the highest state health covers in India
additional_perks: Covers OPD, IPD, and critical illness
No premium for BPL and state govt employee families
₹850/year premium for non-BPL families

steps: Visit chiranjeevi.rajasthan.gov.in or nearest E-Mitra kiosk
Register using Jan Aadhaar number
Select policy category (BPL / non-BPL)
Pay premium if applicable (₹850 for non-BPL)
Download policy document and use at empanelled hospitals

schemes.ministry: Government of Tamil Nadu - Social Welfare Department

special_categories: Women head of household in Tamil Nadu

benefits.summary: ₹1,000 per month financial assistance directly to women heads of households in Tamil Nadu
additional_perks: Directly credited to woman's bank account
No conditions on end-use of funds

documents_required: Bank Account Passbook linked to Aadhaar
Self-declaration of not being a government employee or taxpayer

steps: Visit nearest Village Administrative Officer (VAO) or CSC
Submit Aadhaar, ration card (as head of household), and bank details
VAO verifies eligibility and forwards application
₹1,000 credited monthly to bank account after approval

schemes.ministry: Government of Karnataka - Women & Child Development Department

special_categories: Women head of household with BPL / APL ration card in Karnataka

benefits.summary: ₹2,000 per month directly to women heads of household in Karnataka
additional_perks: One of the highest women DBT amounts among Indian states
Credited directly to woman's bank account

documents_required: Bank Account Passbook linked to Aadhaar
Gruha Lakshmi Application Form (from Gram Panchayat / ULB)

steps: Visit sevasindhu.karnataka.gov.in or nearest CSC / Gram Panchayat
Register using Aadhaar and ration card
Fill Gruha Lakshmi application form
Upload documents and submit
₹2,000 credited monthly after verification and approval

schemes.ministry: Government of West Bengal - Women & Child Development & Social Welfare Department

benefits.summary: Monthly support: ₹1,000 for SC/ST women and ₹500 for general category women in West Bengal
additional_perks: No conditions on usage
Part of West Bengal Duare Sarkar initiative

documents_required: Bank Account Passbook linked to Aadhaar
Lakshmir Bhandar Application Form (from Duare Sarkar camp / block office)

steps: Visit nearest Duare Sarkar camp or block development office
Collect and fill Lakshmir Bhandar application form
Submit Aadhaar, ration card, and bank details
Submit caste certificate for SC/ST category
Monthly DBT credited after document verification

schemes.ministry: Government of Uttar Pradesh - Women & Child Development Department

exclusions: Families with more than 2 children (with exceptions for twins)
special_categories: Girl children born on or after 1 April 2019

benefits.summary: ₹15,000 total in 6 milestone-based installments linked to girl's education from birth to graduation
additional_perks: Linked to girl's education and health milestones
Reduces school dropout rates

documents_required: Income Certificate below ₹3 lakh (from SDM / Tehsildar)

steps: Visit mksy.up.gov.in
Register with mobile number and Aadhaar
Fill girl child's details and select applicable installment stage
Upload all supporting documents
Submit application; installment released after government verification

schemes.ministry: Government of Gujarat - Women & Child Development Department

special_categories: Women Self-Help Group (SHG) members in urban and rural Gujarat

benefits.summary: Interest-free loan up to ₹1 lakh per SHG member for livelihood and micro-enterprise activities
additional_perks: Zero interest for the loan tenure
Covers urban and rural SHG members

documents_required: SHG Membership Certificate and SHG registration proof
MMUY Application Form (from DRDA / DWCD office)

mode: Offline (District Rural Development Agency / DWCD office)
steps: Form or join a registered SHG in Gujarat
Obtain SHG membership certificate from district DWCD office
Apply at DRDA or district Women & Child Development office
Submit SHG membership and identity documents
Loan sanctioned and disbursed to SHG bank account

benefits.summary: ₹10,000 per acre per season (₹20,000/acre/year) investment support directly to farmer's bank account
benefits.frequency: twice a year (Kharif and Rabi seasons)
additional_perks: One of the highest per-acre farmer income support schemes
No upper cap on number of acres
Credited before crop season begins

documents_required: Bank Account Passbook linked to Aadhaar

steps: Ensure Pahani (land records) are updated at local Mandal Revenue Office
Link Aadhaar with bank account
Agriculture department auto-disburses based on Pahani records
Contact Mandal Agriculture Officer if disbursement not received

schemes.ministry: Government of Kerala - Health & Family Welfare Department

special_categories: APL families facing catastrophic health expenditure

benefits.summary: Financial assistance up to ₹5 lakh for critical illnesses and expensive treatments not covered under other schemes
additional_perks: Covers cancer, organ transplant, cardiac surgery, rare diseases
Supports both BPL and APL families in financial distress

documents_required: Medical Certificate / Hospital Estimate and treatment plan

steps: Obtain medical estimate and certificate from treating hospital
Apply at nearest Panchayat / Municipality / Corporation office
Submit income certificate, Aadhaar, and medical documents
District Medical Office verifies and sanctions assistance
Amount disbursed to hospital or patient directly

schemes.ministry: Government of Madhya Pradesh - Women & Child Development Department

eligibility.age_note: Girl child must be registered within 5 years of birth
exclusions: Families with more than 2 children unless twins

benefits.summary: ₹1.43 lakh total financial benefit to girl child through NSC investments and milestone-linked payments up to age 21
additional_perks: NSC certificate in girl's name
Encourages education continuity and delayed marriage

documents_required: Ladli Laxmi Application Form (online or from Anganwadi)

steps: Visit ladlilaxmi.mp.gov.in or nearest Anganwadi centre
Register girl child within 5 years of birth
Fill application form with birth certificate and parent details
Upload documents and submit online or at Anganwadi
NSC investment begins; installments disbursed at milestones

schemes.ministry: Government of Andhra Pradesh - Agriculture Department

special_categories: Landless tenant farmers and agricultural labourers also covered

benefits.summary: ₹13,500 per year to farmers (₹7,500 state + ₹6,000 PM Kisan) along with free crop insurance and zero interest loans
additional_perks: Free crop insurance under PMFBY
Zero interest crop loans
Agricultural inputs support

documents_required: Land Records (Adangal / 1B for land owners) or Tenancy Agreement
Bank Account Passbook linked to Aadhaar
Farmer registration on AP agriculture portal

steps: Visit rythubharosa.ap.gov.in or nearest Rythu Seva Kendra
Register as a farmer with Aadhaar and land / tenancy details
Submit bank details for DBT transfer
Verify via Aadhaar biometric at Kendra
Amount credited annually in installments

schemes.ministry: Government of Odisha - Agriculture & Farmers' Empowerment Department

benefits.summary: ₹4,000 per season (₹2,000/kharif and ₹2,000/rabi) cultivation support + ₹12,500 livelihood support for vulnerable groups
benefits.livelihood_support: ₹12,500 one-time for vulnerable and landless farmers
additional_perks: Free crop insurance
Interest-free crop loans

documents_required: Land Records (ROR - Record of Rights) or Tenancy proof
Bank Account Passbook linked to Aadhaar

steps: Visit kalia.odisha.gov.in or nearest Gram Panchayat
Fill KALIA beneficiary registration form
Submit land records or tenancy proof and Aadhaar
Gram Panchayat verifies eligibility
DBT credited to bank account seasonally

schemes.ministry: Government of Haryana - Chief Minister's Office

special_categories: Families with annual income below ₹1.80 lakh and land below 2 acres

benefits.summary: ₹6,000 per year per family directly to bank account; additional life and accident insurance benefits
additional_perks: ₹2 lakh life insurance (PMJJBY)
₹2 lakh accident insurance (PMSBY)
Pension under APY at age 60
PMFBY crop insurance for farmers

documents_required: Haryana Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP - Family ID)

steps: Ensure family is registered on Haryana Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP) portal
Visit cm-psy.haryana.gov.in or nearest Saral Kendra
Login with Family ID and fill application
Upload income and land documents
₹6,000 credited annually; insurance policies auto-enrolled

special_categories: Farmers in drought-affected districts of Jharkhand

benefits.summary: ₹3,500 per acre compensation (up to 5 acres) for crop loss due to drought or rain failure in Jharkhand
additional_perks: Free seed distribution for next season
Micro-irrigation support

documents_required: Bank Account Passbook linked to Aadhaar
Crop Loss Certificate (from Patwari / Agriculture Officer)

steps: Register at agri.jharkhand.gov.in or visit Block Agriculture Office
Submit crop loss certificate from Patwari
Attach land records and bank details
District Agriculture Officer verifies loss
Compensation credited to bank account

schemes.ministry: Government of Punjab - Food, Civil Supplies & Consumer Affairs Department

benefits.summary: 5 kg wheat flour (atta) and 1 kg dal per person per month at highly subsidised rates for BPL and SC families
additional_perks: Pre-processed atta instead of raw wheat
Higher nutritional value than raw grain

documents_required: Punjab Ration Card (Blue for BPL / Yellow for SC)
Aadhaar Card (for biometric authentication at ration shop)

steps: Obtain Punjab ration card from food office or CSC
Visit Fair Price Shop (ration depot) monthly
Authenticate with Aadhaar biometric
Collect monthly atta and dal allocation

benefits.summary: ₹1,250 per month directly to one woman member per eligible family in Assam
additional_perks: Empowers women with financial independence
No restriction on end-use of funds

documents_required: Bank Account Passbook linked to Aadhaar
Orunodoi Application Form (from Circle Office / CSC)

steps: Visit nearest Circle Office, CSC, or Gaon Panchayat
Collect and fill Orunodoi application form
Submit Aadhaar, voter ID, and bank details
Verification by Circle Officer
₹1,250 credited monthly after approval

benefits.summary: ₹9,000 per year (₹3 installments of ₹3,000) for paddy and maize farmers; ₹7,000 for other crops; ₹7,000 for landless labourers
additional_perks: Covers landless agricultural workers (unique feature)
Supports both Kharif and Rabi crops

documents_required: Land Records (P-II / Khasra) or Tenancy Certificate
Bank Account Passbook linked to Aadhaar
RGKNY Registration Form (from Patwari / Agriculture Office)

steps: Visit rgkny.cg.gov.in or nearest Patwari / Block Agriculture Office
Fill RGKNY registration form with crop and land details
Submit land records and bank details
Patwari verifies crop sowing details
DBT credited in 3 installments annually

schemes.ministry: Government of Himachal Pradesh - Health & Family Welfare Department

special_categories: BPL patients with serious chronic diseases

benefits.summary: ₹3,000 per month to BPL patients suffering from serious chronic diseases for treatment and sustenance
additional_perks: Covers 7 serious chronic diseases
Provides sustenance support for long-term treatment

documents_required: BPL Ration Card or BPL Certificate
Medical Certificate from Government Hospital confirming disease
Bank Account Passbook linked to Aadhaar
Sahara Yojana Application Form (from CHC / District Hospital)

mode: Offline (CHC / District Hospital / Block Medical Office)
steps: Visit nearest government hospital or Community Health Centre (CHC)
Obtain medical certificate confirming chronic disease
Fill Sahara Yojana application form
Submit BPL certificate, Aadhaar, and medical certificate
District Medical Officer approves; ₹3,000 credited monthly

schemes.ministry: Government of Goa - Social Welfare Department

benefits.summary: Monthly financial assistance of ₹2,000-₹3,000 to senior citizens, disabled persons, widows, and destitute people in Goa
additional_perks: Covers multiple vulnerable categories
One of the higher state pension amounts in India

documents_required: Goa Domicile Certificate (15 years residence proof)
Age Proof (Birth Certificate / School Leaving Certificate)
Disability Certificate from Government Hospital (for disabled)
DSSS Application Form (from Social Welfare Department)

steps: Visit nearest Social Welfare Department office or CSC
Collect DSSS application form
Fill form and attach all supporting documents
Submit to Social Welfare Department for verification
District Social Welfare Officer approves
Monthly pension credited to bank account

schemes.ministry: Government of Rajasthan - Women & Child Development Department

special_categories: Pregnant women and lactating mothers for second child

benefits.summary: ₹6,000 to pregnant women and lactating mothers for second child in 5 installments linked to health milestones
additional_perks: Linked to health check-ups and immunisation
Promotes institutional delivery

documents_required: Bank Account Passbook linked to Aadhaar

steps: Register pregnancy with nearest ANM or Anganwadi Sevika
Obtain MCP card and IGMPY beneficiary card
Attend all ANC check-ups as per schedule
Each installment released after verification of milestone
Deliver at government hospital for 3rd installment

schemes.ministry: Government of Karnataka - Food, Civil Supplies & Consumer Affairs Department

special_categories: BPL ration card holders in Karnataka (Antyodaya and PHH)

benefits.summary: 5 kg free rice per person per month to BPL families in addition to central PMGKAY allocation
additional_perks: Karnataka provides additional 5 kg over central allocation
Total 10 kg rice per person per month for eligible families

documents_required: Karnataka BPL Ration Card (Antyodaya or PHH)
Aadhaar Card (for biometric authentication at ration shop)

steps: Obtain Karnataka BPL ration card from Tahsildar office or CSC
Visit Fair Price Shop monthly
Authenticate via Aadhaar biometric on ePoS machine
Collect free rice allocation

schemes.ministry: Government of Tamil Nadu - Health & Family Welfare Department

special_categories: All pregnant women delivering at government hospitals in Tamil Nadu

benefits.summary: Free maternity nutrition kit worth ₹4,000 containing nutritious food items for pregnant women delivering at govt hospitals
additional_perks: Kit includes nutrition-rich items: milk powder, rice, dal, oil, soya, eggs
Encourages institutional delivery at government hospitals

documents_required: Pregnancy Registration Card (from PHC / Government Hospital)

steps: Register pregnancy at nearest Primary Health Centre (PHC) or Government Hospital
Attend all antenatal check-ups
Deliver baby at Tamil Nadu government hospital
Kit provided at time of discharge

special_categories: Students scoring 80%+ in Class 10 (for diploma) or 75%+ in Class 12 (for degree courses)

benefits.summary: Tuition fee waiver up to ₹2 lakh/year and hostel charges up to ₹1.2 lakh/year for meritorious students from low-income families
additional_perks: Covers engineering, medical, and professional courses
Renewable each year on academic performance

documents_required: Income Certificate (below ₹6 lakh from competent authority)

steps: Visit mysy.guj.nic.in
Register with Aadhaar and mobile number
Fill student profile and academic details
Upload class 10/12 marksheet and income certificate
Upload college fee receipt
Submit application before deadline

schemes.ministry: Government of Maharashtra - General Administration Department

benefits.summary: Doorstep delivery of 100+ government certificates and services (income, caste, domicile, pension) to vulnerable citizens at home
additional_perks: No need to visit government offices
Government representative visits home
Covers income certificate, caste certificate, domicile certificate, pension applications

documents_required: Relevant documents specific to service requested

steps: Call helpline 1800-120-8040 or visit aaplesarkar.mahaonline.gov.in
Request doorstep service with Aadhaar and address
Government officer schedules home visit
Officer collects documents and processes request at home
Certificate / service delivered within stipulated time

schemes.ministry: Government of Haryana - Skill Development & Industrial Training Department

benefits.summary: Government job placement portal for contractual government positions with ESI/EPF benefits and fixed salary
additional_perks: ESI and EPF benefits for all contractual workers
Transparent merit-based selection
Jobs in 500+ government departments

documents_required: Haryana Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP / Family ID)

steps: Visit hkrnl.itiharyana.gov.in
Register with Parivar Pehchan Patra (Family ID) and Aadhaar
Create detailed job profile with education and skill details
Apply for available government contractual positions
Appear for merit-based selection process
Receive appointment letter and join duty
